claims.text: The data was collected using the crowdsourcing platform CrowdFlower.
The dataset consists of conversational dialogs with workers on CrowdFlower.
Templates and keywords for the dataset were manually collected from frequent expressions used by CF workers.
The dataset enables interactive learning and evaluation of dialog systems.
